title: rhobound.fit/v1
description: The fit record `rhobound fit` writes (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.1). This schema fixes the summary fields other components read (the server's fit age, baseline pointer and job results; the gate's fit checks). The rest of the record is the engine's lossless mirror of the inference (topology, per-service statistics with their lower-bound flags, observed values) and is open here: it is read only by the CLI that wrote it, so the object allows other keys. The record is canonical JSON; its id is the sha256 of those bytes. Floats that may be non-finite use defs Float.

capture.description: the --name given to `fit`, else the capture argument (or the manifest's path) exactly as given; report v1's `capture` field is filled from it

workers.description: pinned workers per pod by service (--workers)

window.description: the capture's window; the fit's age is measured from its end

images.description: running image digests by service, as the resources reported them; two for one service is trace.mixed_images

client_spans.description: its callers' calls carry CLIENT spans (the gate's lower-bound worker rule needs them)

services.description: per service, the summary the server and the gate read; the full statistics are in the open part of the record
